title: SSC Junior Engineer JE Online Form 2026 – Apply Online
postName: Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Telecom) and Scientific Assistant (IMD)
vacancyDetails: 1,748 tentative vacancies across participating Government of India departments and organisations
qualification: Degree or diploma in the relevant engineering discipline for JE posts. Scientific Assistant (IMD) requires a bachelor's degree with Physics or a relevant Computer Science, Electronics, IT, Instrumentation or Telecommunication qualification. Exact qualification varies by post and organisation.
ageLimit: 18 years minimum; maximum 32 years for CPWD posts and 30 years for other posts, as on 01 Aug 2026. Age relaxation applies as per SSC rules.
applicationFee: ₹100 for General/OBC/EWS male candidates. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted.
selectionProcess: Paper-I Computer Based Examination (qualifying) → Paper-II Computer Based Examination (merit) → Document Verification. BRO posts also require physical and medical standards.
documentsRequired: OTR details, Aadhaar or valid ID, live photograph, scanned signature, educational certificates, category/PwBD/experience certificate where applicable
howToApply:
1. Complete One-Time Registration on https://ssc.gov.in
2. Open the Junior Engineer Examination 2026 application under Live Examinations
3. Select the eligible post, engineering subject and examination centres
4. Upload or capture the required photograph and signature
5. Pay the fee if applicable and submit the form before 22 September 2026
6. Save the submitted application for future reference
shortDescription: SSC Junior Engineer JE 2026 online form for 1,748 tentative Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Telecom and Scientific Assistant posts. Apply at ssc.gov.in before 22 September 2026.
content:
The Staff Selection Commission has released the Junior Engineer Examination 2026 notification for 1,748 tentative vacancies in participating Government of India departments and organisations.

Eligible engineering diploma or degree holders can apply for Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and Telecom Junior Engineer posts. The examination also includes Scientific Assistant posts in the India Meteorological Department, subject to the post-specific qualification in the official notice.

Paper-I is qualifying in nature and Paper-II determines merit. Candidates should verify the organisation-wise qualification, age limit, experience and physical or medical requirements before submitting the application.
